capabilities: : Move completed todos to bottom of sections
: Collect todos from all previous daily notes
extras: Automatic rollover can conflict with the Templater plugin. Requires specific note naming conventions (YYYY-MM-DD) in the daily note folder.
intentEvidence: This Obsidian plugin will rollover any incomplete todo items from the previous daily note (could be yesterday, or a week ago) to today.
motivation: The plugin extends previous ideas for rolling over daily todos.
problem: Users struggle to track and carry over incomplete tasks across multiple days when using daily note systems.

relations.evidence: It extends Rollover Daily Todos by Lukas Mölschl
relations.plugin: Rollover Daily Todos by Lukas Mölschl

relations.evidence: which built on the original rollover-daily-todos idea by Matthew Sessions
relations.plugin: original rollover-daily-todos idea by Matthew Sessions

summary: Rollover Daily Todos with Context automatically or manually moves unfinished todo items from previous daily notes into the current daily note, maintaining context.
